evidence: Saturation is the Benson and Krause fit (Garcia & Gordon 1992) with Benson & Krause's pressure factor, extended from its stated 1.1 atm to the Moon's 1.2, for the air's 17.46% O2 and the held fresh seas' salinity. The lakes are a one-dimensional model (biosphere/ecology/lake.py) checked against analytic diffusion, convective and wind deepening, reaeration and conduction-limited ice, with heat and oxygen conserved to round-off, forced from the GCM's 3-day means at the T21 cells holding three crater lakes: the design case (the lock) and the test with the longwave refitted by height and ice optics (the hot world), years 10-19, the resort interpolated between them by the ground's temperature, which mixes two physics. Oxygen demand is bounded scenarios from published lakes on Earth (design guesses where labelled), and the lunar gravity enters every buoyancy term. The runs are calculations on one GCM's climate at T21; no lunar lake has been measured.
reading_rule: Oxygen in g/m3 (mg/L); quantiles are lists of the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles. saturation.targets gives each target's seas at their median and band temperatures at 1.2 atm, and three_day_means the distribution over the GCM's water cells at each cell's own pressure, the resort interpolated by the share of the way as climate_targets does. runs.deep and runs.shallow are keyed target/band; each case's oxygen is keyed trophic/transfer/kinetics: transfer 'renewal' (Tedford et al. 2014, central) or 'cole_caraco'; kinetics 'supply' (demand fixed by the trophic state) or 'warm' (respiration with 0.62 eV from 20 C, production held). The variant runs keep the central renewal/supply columns. mixing.complete_overturns counts the lunar cycles, sunrise to sunrise at the site, in which the mixed layer reached the bottom layer, and deepest_m each cycle's deepest mixing; deepest_tenth is the deepest tenth of the lake's volume; overturns reads the oxygen after each complete overturn. nights run from sunset to sunrise and days from sunrise to sunset; surface_minimum is each night's lowest surface oxygen and surface_minimum_share_of_the_night when it falls. runs.sensitivity varies the dissipation below the mixed layer, the solutes and the trophic state the physics follows at the 0-15 lake; runs.deepest takes that lake to the 1,925 m deepest point that half the lake area exceeds, oxygenated at the start; runs.resort_from_hot builds the resort from the hot world's weather. checks.slab compares a 50-m mixed slab with the GCM's own slab ocean; checks.resolution drives the lakes from 6.4-hour means and from their 3-day means.
